This format takes the course on the Europeanisation and the economy case study for a reader who works alone, without a facilitator and without a class, in five stages and at your own pace. Its claim is one made by the original author (OA) [@Teney2016DoesEUEconomic] that five analysts reanalysed for the SCORE robustness study [@AczelEtAl2026InvestigatingAnalyticalRobustness]. The modules of the [companion curriculum](../../companion/index.qmd) sit between the tasks of the exercise, each at the point where the case study first needs its method, and the route ends on a project of your own.

You leave with a case-study report and a project of your own, both in a version-controlled repository that another person can clone and re-render.

## How you work

No programming is assumed: stage 1 installs R, Quarto, an IDE (Positron, RStudio, VS Code, etc.) and the downloadable workspace of the case study, and stage 2 teaches enough R to start the case study. You work in the workspace on your own machine, and the browser lab, a page of the course site on which R runs inside your browser, holds every task as well, with hints and worked solutions, and carries the work if your installation fails.

[Install R and the workspace](stage-1.qmd#the-workspace){.btn .btn-primary} [Open the browser lab](../../lab.qmd){.btn .btn-outline-primary target="_blank"}

The five tasks of the [exercise](exercise.qmd#the-tasks) fall to the stages as follows: stage 1 takes Task 1, stage 3 Tasks 2 and 3, and stage 4 Tasks 4 and 5.

Where a stage can be shortened for a reader who already knows part of its material, its page says how, in a paragraph headed **Shortcuts**. The [help page](https://codemoreh.github.io/ar4ds/help.html) lists the problems that other participants have met.

Sending your results to the class chart on the [Class results page](../../class-results.qmd) is optional. To find your own marks again, give the same nickname every time, as `nickname = "..."`.

## The stages

| Stage | What you do | Time |
|---|---|---:|
| [Stage 1 – Credibility and the three Rs](stage-1.qmd) | Why the field talks of a crisis, reproduction, robustness and replication, SCORE and its robustness study, and R, Quarto, an IDE and the workspace installed | 5 h 15 |
| [Stage 2 – R and Quarto](stage-2.qmd) | A first session in R, R on the panel of the case study, the document format of the report, and the paper with the first sections of the background page | 5 h 50 |
| [Stage 3 – From respondents to a panel](stage-3.qmd) | Sixteen Eurobarometer files turned into country-years, the estimand statement and the causal graph, a recorded result reproduced, and the models of a panel | 6 h 45 |
| [Stage 4 – Few clusters and the multiverse](stage-4.qmd) | Tasks 4 and 5 on the curve of 864, inference with 27 countries, the multiverse and its critics, missing answers, the case-study report and the choice of a project | 6 h 35 |
| [Stage 5 – Your own project](stage-5.qmd) | Version control, a question beyond the claim, preregistered before it runs, and a repository ready for an archive | 6 h 15 |
| The route | | 30 h 40 |
